newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London steady, await jobs numbers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London steady, await jobs numbers.

text.p: U.S. shares were steady in thin trade on Friday as European participants awaited U.S. unemployment and wage inflation data, due at 1230 GMT.
"Things are very quiet but if there are no surprises in the jobs numbers, this market looks as if it will go higher today," one dealer said.

The U.S. non-farm payroll total for May is forecast to rise by 221,000, according to a Reuters poll of economists. Average hourly earnings are seen up 0.4 percent on the month after dropping 0.1 percent in April.
Stronger-than-expected figures would raise market fears of a near-term U.S. Federal Reserve rate hike, dealers said.
High-technology issues were generally firm, led by Intel Corp, up $3/4 to $144-7/8. IBM gained $1/4 to $84-1/8 while Compaq added $3/8 to $100.

Elsewhere, Eli Lilly and Co rose $3/8 to $93-1/2 after the company said results from trials of its new anti-osteoporosis drug raloxifene showed that it increased bone mass while producing fewer side effects than estrogen replacement therapy currently in use.
